metas.name: 1. Homer's Barbershop Quartet
metas.description: Homer recalls when he, Apu, Barney and Principal Skinner became recording icons.

metas.name: 2. Cape Feare
metas.description: The Simpsons go incognito to avoid the newly paroled Sideshow Bob, who's out to get Bart.

metas.name: 3. Homer Goes to College
metas.description: Homer takes Nuclear Physics 101 at the local college, where he gets a trio of nerdy tutors expelled for extracurricular activities.

metas.name: 4. Rosebud
metas.description: Burns longs for a childhood toy that winds up in the grip of Maggie.

metas.name: 5. Treehouse of Horror IV
metas.description: Homer sells his soul; Vampire Burns invites the Simpsons for dinner; Bart sees a gremlin damaging his school bus.

metas.name: 6. Marge on the Lam
metas.description: Marge's wild night out with neighbor Ruth includes running from the police in Ruth's car, stolen from her ex.

metas.name: 7. Bart's Inner Child
metas.description: Springfield emulates Bart after he's praised by a self-help guru.

metas.name: 8. Boy-Scoutz 'N the Hood
metas.description: After a reckless Squishee bender with Milhouse, Bart wakes to the shocking realization that he joined the Junior Campers. Lured by pocketknives and knot-tying lessons, Bart assimilates into the group but then must face the father-son rafting trip.

metas.name: 9. The Last Temptation of Homer
metas.description: Homer struggles with his attraction to new coworker Mindy, a beautiful engineer whose love for doughnuts is equal to his own.

metas.name: 10. $pringfield (Or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
metas.description: Legalized gambling comes to Springfield, and Marge becomes addicted; Robert Goulet entertains at Bart's casino for kids.

metas.name: 11. Homer the Vigilante
metas.description: Homer leads a vigilante group to catch the Springfield Cat Burglar, who then robs the museum.

metas.name: 12. Bart Gets Famous
metas.description: When an on-air remark catapults Bart to instant stardom, he finds that fame isn't all it's cracked up to be.

metas.name: 13. Homer and Apu
metas.description: Homer accompanies Apu to the Kwik-E-Mart home office--in India--after Apu is fired.

metas.name: 14. Lisa vs. Malibu Stacy
metas.description: Lisa's outrage over the gender stereotypes reinforced by a new talking doll prompts her to confront the dollmaker.

metas.name: 15. Deep Space Homer
metas.description: Homer and Barney compete to be the first "average" American in space.

metas.name: 16. Homer Loves Flanders
metas.description: Flanders' extra ticket to the big game makes him Homer's new best friend, a role that sorely tests Flanders' patience.

metas.name: 17. Bart Gets an Elephant
metas.description: Bart wins an elephant, but Homer won't let him keep it.

metas.name: 18. Burns' Heir
metas.description: Bart is picked to be Burns' heir and moves into the Burns mansion, prompting Homer and Marge to hire a deprogrammer to get him back.

metas.name: 19. Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
metas.description: Bart takes his dog to school, which gets Skinner fired, which in turn leaves Bart missing his archnemesis.

metas.name: 20. The Boy Who Knew Too Much
metas.description: Bart can clear Mayor Quimby's nephew of a charge of battery, but only by implicating himself as a hooky player.

metas.name: 21. Lady Bouvier's Lover
metas.description: Grandpa Simpson falls for Marge's mother, but loses out to a competitor; Bart gets ripped off shopping at home with Homer's credit card.

metas.name: 22. Secrets of a Successful Marriage
metas.description: Homer teaches a class on marriage, but sharing secrets about his own union gets him kicked out of the house.
